goal: At least 20 percent less elapsed time for the affected quote-free CSV read workload.

protocol.tool: Existing BenchmarkDotNet comparison projects; no new measurement framework.
protocol.settings: InProcessEmit, 8 warmups, 12 measurements, 16 invocations, unroll 1, no outlier removal.
protocol.order: Full 11-lane A1/B1 pair; B2/A2 repeats only the affected OfficeIMO raw/typed lanes and matching ExcelReader.NET controls. Shape controls use 64 invocations.
protocol.statistics: Medians of all retained per-operation result samples. Raw samples and allocations remain separated by leg.
protocol.shapeHosts: Each shape runs in a fresh process, with two methods in-process. A previous combined-shape run trained the new batch branch on Mixed before measuring fallback; that diagnostic is not substituted for isolated-shape evidence.
protocol.serialization: Every build/test/benchmark/profile uses the shared lock; builds use -m:2 and no shared compilation/node reuse.
protocol.hostLimits: Normal priority, no processor affinity or quiet-host claim. Unrelated CI test jobs ran on this host during some shape controls. M4 has performance and efficiency cores. Preserve all samples; unchanged-lane timing movement is not attributed to this change. This is not a portable ranking.
protocol.readBoundary: Existing workload: OfficeIMO opens decoded text through StringReader; ExcelReader.NET consumes prepared UTF-8 bytes. Both return and consume every owned field string. Encoding preparation is outside timing.
protocol.writeBoundary: Prepared projected rows to a finalized UTF-8 MemoryStream; return its byte length. No extra ToArray copy or row preparation is timed.
protocol.validation: Existing Setup validates every field and typed row, and reopens every writer output. Measured scans retain count/checksum work.

reproduction.shell: zsh; quote each filter so the shell does not expand it. Execute each listed command separately, in order, without concurrent benchmark processes.

variables.RUN_ROOT: An absolute, task-owned output directory containing the frozen csv-baseline and csv-cached folders.
variables.HEAVY_LOCK: The existing shared heavy-run lock; /Volumes/Samsung/Development/Scratch/heavy-run.lock on this host.
variables.BASELINE_SOURCE: A separate source checkout at baselineCommit, 41fbfd10e80e81b0e3abddec6020faff6b4b4acd.
variables.CANDIDATE_SOURCE: A separate source checkout at implementationCommit, d50de622e20f9443f555d2da492bb69f76bf189a.

reproduction.freezeChecks: Use new destination folders. Only OfficeIMO.CSV.dll differs between the frozen DLL sets; baselineAssemblies and candidateAssemblies record the measured hashes. The source checkouts are inputs, not branch-switching instructions. Run under the recorded SDK/runtime and packages; a later SDK rebuild need not reproduce identical metadata hashes.
reproduction.selection: K-A1/K-B1 select all eleven generated comparison lanes. K-B2/K-A2 select the four raw/typed OfficeIMO and ExcelReader.NET lanes. Each shape command runs two OfficeIMO methods in its own fresh process; invocation counts are 16 for generated lanes and 64 for shape controls. These are the filters and settings from the retained accepted-run script.
reproduction.workingDirectories: Run each build from its corresponding source checkout root to select the repository SDK. Run the frozen benchmark commands from RUN_ROOT, using the recorded SDK/runtime and package versions.

fixture.validation: Existing Setup validated every participant before fingerprinting the actual benchmark input.

xlsxControl.decision: No elapsed-time improvement; prototype removed completely.

validation.nativeAot: osx-arm64 smoke passed, including 257-row Unicode input above64KiB with batch rollover and quoted fallback.
validation.reviewReproductions: Both original P2 reproductions failed before fixes; final regression theories cover strict/trim batch and oversized fallback plus backend-specific factory failure ordering with and without trimming.
validation.platformLimits: ARM64 net8/net10 and nativeAOT executed. AVX2 runtime and Windows net472 execution were unavailable locally; all four library targets compiled.
